posts.caption: Small habit, big barakah: set one reminder today—not for “productivity,” but for salah. Easy Salah keeps times accurate so you can focus on the prayer, not the math.
posts.image_prompt: Cozy desk scene at blue hour: phone on wooden stand showing a simple prayer-times app UI (no readable text), warm lamp, open notebook with a doodle of a mosque dome, muted teal and amber palette, editorial lifestyle photo, soft grain.
posts.posting_tip: Threads: lead with one short line, then the paragraph. Reply to yourself with a CTA to try the app.

posts.caption: 15 seconds: open the app → check next salah → breathe. That’s it. Save this for when your day feels loud.
posts.video_idea: 0–3s: tight crop thumb tapping app icon. 3–8s: vertical phone screen with abstract blurred UI blocks (no legible text). 8–12s: cut to person exhaling, shoulders drop. 12–15s: text overlay style caption in editor only (burn-in optional): “Next salah, sorted.” Soft lo-fi beat, 1080x1920.
posts.posting_tip: Post between Maghrib and Isha for scroll-heavy evening traffic.
